cues.en: In this video, I'm going to introduce you to inverse functions.
cues.zh: 這支介紹反函數。

cues.en: This is a category of functions that basically negates or like presses the undo button of another function.
cues.zh: 這類函數基本上能抵消另一個，像按復原鍵。

cues.en: Inverse functions are super important in applications like control engineering and optimization and
cues.zh: 在控制工程、最佳化，

cues.en: machine learning and inverse functions also have a pretty interesting relationship to implicit differentiation.
cues.zh: 機器學習等應用非常重要，也和隱函數微分有有趣關係。

cues.en: So you'll see function inverses popping up later again in the course.
cues.zh: 所以後面會再遇到反函數。

cues.en: I'd like to begin with an example from the previous video.
cues.zh: 先從上一支例子。

cues.en: Remember these two pairs of functions?
cues.zh: 還記得這兩組函數？

cues.en: And I actually use this example to show that some function pairs actually are commutative under composition.
cues.zh: 我用來示範某些配對，合成時滿足交換性。

cues.en: So F of g of x produces the same result as g of f of x.
cues.zh: f(g(x)) 和 g(f(x)) 結果相同。

cues.en: Now, in this case, with these two specific functions, you actually discovered that both of these
cues.zh: 這兩個特定函數，你發現，

cues.en: function compositions just reduce to x, so F of x, so the function F transforms x into some other
cues.zh: 兩種合成都化簡成 x；f 把 x 變成另一個，

cues.en: variable, and that transformation is undone when we apply the function g of x.
cues.zh: 變數，再套 g，就撤銷這個變換。

cues.en: And so with this in mind, an inverse function is basically what it sounds like, a function that inverts
cues.zh: 所以反函數如其名，就是反轉，

cues.en: another function, or in other words, a function that undoes the transformation that is applied by a different function.
cues.zh: 另一個函數，撤銷它所套用的變換。

cues.en: So formally, we can write that a function g is the inverse of function.
cues.zh: 正式來說，g 是函數，

cues.en: F If the composition g of F of X gives us back the original variable x.
cues.zh: f 的反函數，如果 g(f(x)) 讓我們得到原本 x。

cues.en: Now it's a little bit tedious and also potentially confusing to to have to write all of this out and also to use different letters for the function and it's inverse.
cues.zh: 全部寫出很繁瑣，也容易混淆，而且函數和反函數要用不同字母。

cues.en: So therefore we use a specific notation instead.
cues.zh: 所以用特定記號。

cues.en: In particular, the inverse function is indicated using a minus one in the superscript.
cues.zh: 用上標負一表示反函數。

cues.en: So this is the indication of the inverse function of F.
cues.zh: 這表示 f 的反函數。

cues.en: Now it is a bit confusing at first because this notation is for the inverse of function F, whereas this notation is actually the reciprocal.
cues.zh: 一開始有點困惑，因為這種記號是反函數，那種則是倒數。

cues.en: So one over F of X and in general these are not the same.
cues.zh: 就是 1/f(x)，一般兩者不同。

cues.en: So the function inverse is not the reciprocal of the function.
cues.zh: 反函數不是函數的倒數。

cues.en: In most cases it's going to be pretty rare where this actually is really also the inverse of the function.
cues.zh: 很少情況，倒數也剛好是反函數。

cues.en: So why do we use this notation?
cues.zh: 為什麼用這記號？

cues.en: Well, for one thing, it helps to link to the concept of the inverse of a number.
cues.zh: 首先能連結數字的反元素概念。

cues.en: So the inverse of the number three is three to the power of minus one, because this is one third and
cues.zh: 三的反元素是 3⁻¹，也就是三分之一，

cues.en: one third times three, kind of negates the three or gives us back an answer of one, which is the identity, the multiplicative identity number.
cues.zh: 乘三就抵消三，得到一，也就是乘法單位元素。

cues.en: Now for numbers, the inverse function actually is the same thing as the reciprocal, but that's generally not the case for functions.
cues.zh: 數字的反元素確實等於倒數，但函數通常不是。

cues.en: Another way to think about this subscript is as being a multiplicative iteration of the function.
cues.zh: 也能把這個上標，想成函數的乘法式迭代。

cues.en: So for example, F squared F to the power of two means F of x times f of x.
cues.zh: 例如 f²，表示 f(x) 乘 f(x)。

cues.en: And in this sense we can write that F to the minus one times F to the minus two gives us our original
cues.zh: 從這角度，可以寫 f⁻¹ 乘這裡的 f 次方（次方口述不清），得到原本的，

cues.en: function F of x because one of the inverses is cancelling out one of these functions.
cues.zh: f(x)，因為一個反函數抵消其中一個函數。

cues.en: And so in this way, along these lines you can also think of the function inverse times, the main function
cues.zh: 沿這思路，反函數和原函數結合，

cues.en: as resulting in F to the zero, which is the identity function, which does nothing whatsoever, it just returns x.
cues.zh: 得到 f⁰，也就是單位函數，什麼都不做，只傳回 x。

cues.en: This is a bit conceptual, but I hope it helps you understand the concept and get the idea that F to the power of minus one is the inverse of function.
cues.zh: 有點概念性，希望幫助你理解，上標負一代表函數，

cues.en: F It is negating the transformation that F is applying to variable X and well, there's more ways to think about the inverse function.
cues.zh: f 的反函數，撤銷 f 對 x 的變換；還有其他理解方式。

cues.en: You can also think about it visually like this.
cues.zh: 也能這樣看圖。

cues.en: So F of x transforms variable x into variable y and the inverse of x.
cues.zh: f(x) 把 x 轉 y，而反函數。

cues.en: So F inverse translates our transforms y kind of, you know, you could call this a backwards translation.
cues.zh: f 的反函數把 y 變回去，可以叫逆向轉換。

cues.en: It's going backwards from Y to our original variable X.
cues.zh: 從 y 回到原本 x。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now I wrote on this slide that the inverse of x F is not the same thing as the reciprocal of F.
cues.zh: 投影片寫，f 的反函數不等於倒數。

cues.en: So then how do you actually compute the inverse?
cues.zh: 那如何計算？

cues.en: Well, it's easier than you might think, at least conceptually.
cues.zh: 至少概念上，比想像容易。

cues.en: You just follow these three steps to do this by hand.
cues.zh: 手算遵循三步。

cues.en: So you write out the function as y equals.
cues.zh: 先寫 y 等於，

cues.en: And then the definition instead of writing F of X equals, and then you do a little bit of algebra and
cues.zh: 函數定義，不寫 f(x) 等於，再用一點代數，

cues.en: solve for X, and then you swap the X and the Y, and that gives you your inverse function F of x.
cues.zh: 解出 x，交換 x、y，就得到反函數。

cues.en: So we're going to go through several examples and we're going to start off with a really easy one.
cues.zh: 看幾個例子，先最簡單。

cues.en: I'm going to do this one for you because it's so easy.
cues.zh: 太簡單，所以我直接做。

cues.en: And in the next several examples, I will encourage you to pause the video and do it yourself.
cues.zh: 下幾題鼓勵暫停自行算。

cues.en: Okay, so here's our function.
cues.zh: 函數在這裡。

cues.en: F of x equals to x plus three.
The first step is to write out this function as Y.
cues.zh: 第一步，寫成 y。

cues.en: So we write y equals to x plus three.
Step two is to apply a bit of algebra to isolate X on one side of the equation.
cues.zh: 第二步，代數操作，把 x 隔離到一邊。

cues.en: So we end up with x equals the quantity Y minus three divided by two.
And then step three is to swap the X and the Y here, and that gives us our function inverse F inverse of x equals x minus three divided by two.
cues.zh: 第三步交換 x、y，得到 f⁻¹(x)=(x−3)/2。

cues.en: So conceptually, pretty straightforward, more complicated, more involved functions get a little bit harder.
cues.zh: 概念很直接，複雜函數則稍難。

cues.en: You know, the algebra gets a little hairier, but once you get the idea, the concept, then the rest of it is really just about the details.
cues.zh: 代數比較棘手，但懂概念後，剩下是細節。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.zh: 最後得到，這函數的反函數是 arcsin(θ)/(2π)。

cues.zh: 很容易畫這兩個。

cues.en: So let's have a look at the graph.

cues.zh: 也許以為像原函數旋轉 90 度。

cues.zh: 的定義域是負一到正一，對應正弦的值域。

cues.zh: 所以函數和反函數的定義域、值域，有有趣關係。
